acts.1.p1.b1.text: In my first book, O Theophilus, I wrote about all that Jesus began to do and to teach,

acts.1.p1.b2.text: After His suffering, He presented Himself to them with many convincing proofs that He was alive. He appeared to them over a span of forty days and spoke about the kingdom of God.

acts.1.p2.b1.text: And while they were gathered together, He commanded them: …

acts.1.p2.b2.text: “Do not leave Jerusalem, but wait for the gift the Father promised, …

acts.1.p2.b3.text: “Lord, will You at this time restore the kingdom to Israel?”

acts.1.p2.b4.text: “It is not for you to know times or seasons that the Father has fixed by His own authority.

acts.1.p3.b1.text: But you will receive power when the Holy Spirit comes upon you, …

acts.1.p3.b2.text: … and you will be My witnesses in Jerusalem, and in all Judea and Samaria, and to the ends of the earth.”

acts.1.p4.b1.text: After He had said this, they watched as He was taken up, …

acts.1.p4.b2.text: … and a cloud hid Him from their sight.

acts.1.p5.b1.text: They were looking intently into the sky as He was going, when suddenly two men dressed in white stood beside them.

acts.1.p5.b2.text: “Men of Galilee,” … “why do you stand here looking into the sky?

acts.1.p5.b3.text: … will come back in the same way you have seen Him go into heaven.”

acts.1.p6.b1.text: Then they returned to Jerusalem from the Mount of Olives, …

acts.1.p6.b2.text: When they arrived, they went to the upper room where they were staying: …

acts.1.p7.b1.text: … along with the women and Mary the mother of Jesus, and with His brothers.

acts.1.p7.b2.text: With one accord they all continued in prayer, …

acts.1.p8.b1.text: In those days Peter stood up among the brothers (a gathering of about a hundred and twenty) and said,

acts.1.p8.b2.text: “Brothers, the Scripture had to be fulfilled … concerning Judas, who became a guide for those who arrested Jesus.

acts.1.p8.b3.text: … ‘May his place be deserted; let there be no one to dwell in it,’ …

acts.1.p9.b1.text: … For one of these must become a witness with us of His resurrection.”

acts.1.p9.b2.text: So they proposed two men: Joseph called Barsabbas (also known as Justus) and Matthias.

acts.1.p10.b1.text: “Lord, You know everyone’s heart. Show us which of these two You have chosen …

acts.1.p10.b3.text: … and the lot fell to Matthias; …

acts.1.p10.b4.text: … so he was added to the eleven apostles.
